supersedes.reason: The author retained an RGB-aware candidate using a 16x16 runtime-observable robot-visibility matrix and a gated residual to the tabular box MLP.

contribution: When the fixed cameras are installed and geometrically calibrated, the same setup period is used to survey the robot at known positions and commission the camera-localization system across the warehouse.

The drives identify deterministic sensor support, spatial availability, candidate measurement corrections and a covariance model matched to each correction, which are then used by the estimator and the existing belief-aware planner to test whether commissioning improves belief prediction, route choice and navigation reliability.
causal_claim: selected correction plus its matched R plus spatial q_i(p)

fixed.environment: locked warehouse, blue robot, five fixed cameras and locked capture map

detector.model: COCO-pretrained YOLO11n fine-tuned for one blue-robot class
detector.paper_role: two methodology sentences; training and validation in appendix

measurement.projection: ground-plane projection already defined in the Problem Statement

candidate_families: raw-box MLP using runtime box and camera features
raw-box MLP plus a zero-initialized gated residual from the 16x16 visibility matrix
correction.target: reference position minus raw projected bounding-box measurement

visibility_patch_candidate.input: 16x16 soft blue-robot visibility matrix pooled inside the detected box
visibility_patch_candidate.form: zero-initialized gated residual added to the raw-box MLP
visibility_patch_candidate.shuffled_control: shuffle visibility matrices within camera on development
visibility_patch_candidate.fallback: retain the raw-box MLP if any predeclared selection gate fails

availability.target: fixed detector hit and deterministic sensor-gate pass
availability.population: all expected camera opportunities including admitted detections, refusals and misses
availability.heading_treatment: pool commissioning outcomes over headings sampled at each position
availability.runtime_role: future-observation forecast only; never an acceptance or route-feasibility gate

covariance.pairing_rule: every correction candidate receives a fresh R learned from that candidate's residuals
covariance.residual_source: whole-drive out-of-fold residuals from the paired correction
candidates: image-conditioned runtime covariance with planner spatial marginal
fast residual covariance plus augmented persistent-bias state

fixed.runtime: fixed detector -> deterministic sensor gate -> ground projection -> selected correction -> matched R query -> correlation-aware multi-camera fusion -> estimator NIS -> belief update

estimator.primary: one robot filter consuming each physical camera frame once
estimator.persistent_error: use an augmented joint state when commissioned residual dependence justifies it
estimator.prohibited: a first filter posterior reused as a fresh independent measurement by a second filter

planner.shared_route_policy: identical candidates and geometric/rollout feasibility in every condition
planner.availability_effect: expected information and cost only; never route eligibility

main_conditions.C00: selected runtime sensor model with constant future q and constant future R forecasts
main_conditions.C01: same selected runtime sensor model with constant future q and commissioned planner-queryable R forecast
main_conditions.C10: same selected runtime sensor model with commissioned q_i(p) and constant future R forecast
main_conditions.C11: same selected runtime sensor model with commissioned q_i(p) and commissioned planner-queryable R forecast

navigation_analysis.retention: Retain every run and outcome even if C01 and C10 are later moved to the appendix or omitted from the main text for space.

main_results: runtime agreement of commissioned q and R along executed routes
method_figures: point-level raw and corrected commissioning residuals
spatial matched-R and q_i(p) fields over the underlying opportunity points

fixed_invariants: the fixed detector and deterministic belief-independent sensor gate
q_i(p) predicts detector hit and sensor-gate pass and excludes NIS
q_i(p) uses position only; R may use position and heading
each R is learned from whole-drive out-of-fold residuals of its paired correction
an image-conditioned runtime R exposes a planner-queryable spatial marginal
navigation evaluation data fit or select neither correction nor R
all navigation conditions share candidates and feasibility
one robot filter consumes each frame once
pending: whether residual dependence justifies an augmented bias state

change_control: Do not change a fixed decision from configuration convenience, an existing artifact or a new diagnostic. Obtain an explicit user decision and create a versioned amendment first.
